test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: reasoning
question: Mridul cycles 145 m towards the east, and then turns left and cycles 155 m. Again, he turns left and cycles 225 m. He finally turns left and cycles 95 m to reach his home. What is the shortest distance between his home and the starting point?
solution: • Mridul cycles 145 m towards the east [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0df9930d80aac70143e6767791568ac6438bcd8e83f94c91cd4db7d293f619d3.png] • and then turns left and cycles 155 m. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/716ceded698510656ba9b725541aca5a52efa08386398adbfb93138379bb7aa3.png] • Again, he turns left and cycles 225 m.
